title: introduce-live-socket-tool-bridge-playground-and-step-debug-docs
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Add an interactive developer quickstart that demonstrates a WebSocket-based tool-bridge for RAG agents to enable low-latency streaming tool calls and a stepwise live debugger experience. This change delivers a self-contained playground, step debugger guide, and lightweight smoke CI to help SDK users and doc readers iterate on tool-calling workflows quickly. What changed: added user-facing docs, a runnable example, CI smoke job, and diagram assets. Included friction-free local run instructions and a minimal Docker Compose for the bridge and a toy indexer. Checklist: - [x] Author guide and quickstart; - [x] Example code and local runner; - [x] CI smoke test; - [x] Telemetry probe examples; - [x] Cross-link from RAG authoring index. How to try locally: follow examples/playground/live-socket/README.md to run docker-compose up, visit http://localhost:8080/dev-playground, trigger sample session, and open the DEBUG UI at /debug/trace. Security notes: the playground runs without auth by design on localhost and includes a clear WARN banner in the README and docs page describing production hardening (KMS, TLS, RBAC). Backwards-compatibility: no API changes to the public SDKs; example uses existing tool contract interfaces. Impact: lowers barrier to exploring streaming tool-calls and makes debugging agent-tool interactions observable for developers.
commits: 4 commits: 1) Add live-socket playground docs, samples and assets (author: Ava Martinez); 2) Teach CI to spin up playground smoke container and e2e probe (author: Ava Martinez); 3) Fix cross-link and add diagram alt text (author: Ava Martinez); 4) Pin ws library to 8.6.0 to address flakiness on CI (author: Ava Martinez).
review_comments: Liam Chen: Nice incremental doc. Nit: can we call out port mapping upfront? Also suggest a short curl example to validate the bridge health endpoint. Author: added health curl in README and top-level note.
Rhea Gupta: CI smoke failed on first run due to ws 9.x breaking change. Requested pin and a retry on CI. Author: pinned to 8.6.0 and re-ran tests, CI passed.
Noah Patel: Suggest adding a quick troubleshooting subsection for common permission errors when running Docker on WSL. Author: added subsection and tests for the scenario.
merge_outcome: squash and merge into main; commit message summarized the docs and included a pointer to ENG-1138; PR merged after CI green and approvals.
release_notes: Added a new 'Live socket tool-bridge playground' quickstart and debugger guide under 'Guides > RAG examples'. Includes runnable example, diagram, and a CI smoke job to keep the playground healthy.
